title: The Time of the End

questions.question: At that time shall arise Michael, the great prince who has charge of whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:1 (ESV): "At that time shall arise Michael, the great prince who has charge of your people."

questions.question: There shall be a time of trouble, such as never has been since when?
options: There was a nation till that time
questions.correctAnswer: There was a nation till that time
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:1 (ESV): "And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never has been since there was a nation till that time."

questions.question: Who shall be delivered at that time?
options: Everyone whose name shall be found written in the book
questions.correctAnswer: Everyone whose name shall be found written in the book
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:1 (ESV): "But at that time your people shall be delivered, everyone whose name shall be found written in the book."

questions.question: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:2 (ESV): "And many of those who sleep... shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt."

questions.question: Those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:3 (ESV): "And those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky above;"

questions.question: Daniel was told to shut up the words and seal the book until when?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:4 (ESV): "But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, until the time of the end."

questions.question: Daniel saw two others standing on opposite banks of the stream. One asked the man in linen, "How long shall it be till the end of these wonders?" What was the answer?
options: A time, times, and half a time
It is not for you to know
questions.correctAnswer: A time, times, and half a time
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:7 (ESV): "he swore by him who lives forever that it would be for a time, times, and half a time,"

questions.question: Many shall purify themselves and make themselves white and be refined, but the wicked shall do what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:10 (ESV): "but the wicked shall act wickedly. And none of the wicked shall understand,"

questions.question: From the time that the regular burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate is set up, there shall be how many days?
Blessed is he who waits and arrives at how many days?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:12 (ESV): "Blessed is he who waits and arrives at the 1,335 days."

questions.question: What was Daniel told to do regarding his own future?
options: Go your way till the end
questions.correctAnswer: Go your way till the end
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:13 (ESV): "But go your way till the end. And you shall rest and shall stand in your allotted place at the end of the days."

questions.question: When the shattering of the power of the holy people comes to an end, all these things would be what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:7 (ESV): "and that when the shattering of the power of the holy people comes to an end all these things would be finished."

questions.question: Many shall run to and fro, and what shall increase?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:4 (ESV): "Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase."

questions.question: Who shall turn many to righteousness like the stars forever and ever?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:3 (ESV): "and those who turn many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever."

questions.question: Did Daniel understand what he heard?
questions.explanation: Daniel 12:8 (ESV): "I heard, but I did not understand. Then I said, 'O my lord, what shall be the outcome of these things?'"

key_verse_text: And those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky above; and those who turn many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
